verification: Both policies and hashes matched the fixed protocol. Every game replayed from its named procedural_v2 map and student root seat. Native replanned teacher was queried only at first states of root turns1,4,8,12; its actions were not applied. The SSH server passed 478 Python tests and Ruff with one pinned nice19 CPU.
interpretation: Changing the opponent does change some encountered student states, but this small old-fit replay does not show a consistent loss of teacher-action fidelity or early coarse territory/economy state under the source opponent. At turn12 the source-opponent arm even has a higher median territory lead and more student-teacher matches in seat0 among surviving pairs. This weakens the simple opponent-distribution-mismatch explanation of the failed fresh game gate; it neither proves the explanation false nor establishes a causal mechanism or game strength.
stop_rule: Do not use these previously inspected fit maps to choose an opponent-mix recipe, tune teacher agreement, retrain the rejected student, run reserved teacher/final seeds, rate/deploy a student, or change the playable/rated bot.
